nodes.content: Develop streaming speech recognition that handles temporarily ambiguous speech accurately while committing words irreversibly with low latency.
requirements: Achieve word error rate within 5% relative of an equally trained revisable streaming baseline.
Keep 95th-percentile word-end-to-commit latency below 800 milliseconds, with zero revisions after commitment.

nodes.content: Train a revision-risk gate on streaming hypothesis histories; commit buffered words below calibrated risk or at a 650-ms word-end deadline.
What fraction of temporarily ambiguous words remain high-risk at the 650-ms forced-commit deadline?
On ambiguity-tagged StreamMix words, fewer than 8% exceed 10% calibrated revision risk at the 650-ms deadline.
Calibrate revision risk on StreamMix-dev, replay ambiguity-tagged StreamMix-test, and count words exceeding 10% risk at the 650-ms word-end deadline.
On ambiguity-tagged StreamMix-test, 6.4% of words exceeded 10% calibrated revision risk at the 650-ms word-end deadline.
Retain the 650-ms forced-commit deadline for prototyping because only 6.4% of ambiguity-tagged words exceed 10% revision risk.
Implement 650-ms risk-gated commits; test StreamMix-test WER within 5% relative of equally-trained revisable baseline, p95 <800 ms, zero revisions.
Implement the 650-ms risk-gated decoder and replay StreamMix-test against an equally trained revisable baseline, measuring WER, p95 latency, and revisions.
StreamMix v1 decoder and replay report containing immutable commit logs, WER comparison, p95 word-end latency, and post-commit revision counts.
Independently audit StreamMix v1 commit logs and replay report for relative WER gap, p95 latency, and zero post-commit revisions.
StreamMix-test audit: gated WER 12.5% versus equally trained revisable 12.0% (4.2% relative); p95 latency 682 ms; zero post-commit revisions.
Among overlapping-speaker, ambiguity-tagged StreamMix words, over 13% exceed 10% revision risk at the 650-ms word-end deadline.
Stratify ambiguity-tagged StreamMix-test words by overlapping-speaker annotation and measure the fraction above 10% calibrated revision risk at 650 ms.
Among overlapping-speaker, ambiguity-tagged StreamMix-test words, 11.2% exceeded 10% calibrated revision risk at the 650-ms deadline.
Does revision-risk calibration transfer to far-field speech while preserving the 5% relative WER gap and 800-ms p95 latency limits?
Replay the unchanged risk gate on far-field RoomMix-test against an equally trained revisable baseline; measure WER, p95 latency, revisions.
RoomMix-test: unchanged gate WER 18.2% versus revisable 17.0% (7.1% relative); p95 latency 714 ms; zero revisions.
Add far-field-conditioned risk calibration and overlap-aware N-best rescoring before the 650-ms deadline, retaining irreversible commits.
Can far-field calibration and overlap-aware rescoring close RoomMix’s 7.1% relative WER gap without increasing p95 latency beyond 800 ms?
On RoomMix-test, far-field calibration plus overlap-aware rescoring reduces WER to ≤17.8%, with p95 latency <800 ms and zero revisions.
Using RoomMix’s 18.2% WER result, tune far-field calibration and overlap-aware rescoring on RoomMix-dev; evaluate RoomMix-test WER, p95 latency, revisions.
RoomMix-test: calibrated rescoring yields 17.7% WER versus revisable 17.0% (4.1% relative), 746-ms p95 latency, zero revisions.
Adopt far-field-calibrated, overlap-aware rescoring: RoomMix meets all targets, while 11.2% of overlapping ambiguous words exceed 10% deadline risk.
Validate adopted rescoring on held-out RoomMix speaker/noise strata; compare WER, p95 latency, and revisions against the revisable baseline.
Extend StreamMix v1’s immutable-commit replay harness to audit held-out RoomMix speaker/noise strata against revisable WER, p95 latency, and revisions.
RoomMix strata audit report with speaker/noise-sliced WER gaps, p95 word-end commit latencies, and immutable-commit revision counts.
Recompute RoomMix speaker/noise WER gaps and p95 commit latencies from raw logs; verify report thresholds and zero revisions.
RoomMix speaker/noise audit: worst-stratum relative WER gap 4.8%, maximum stratum p95 commit latency 781 ms, zero post-commit revisions.
Far-field-conditioned calibration alone yields RoomMix-test WER ≤17.85% versus revisable 17.0%, p95 latency <800 ms, and zero revisions.
Using StreamMix v1 and RoomMix strata audits, replay unchanged gate, calibration-only, and combined rescoring; compare WER, p95 latency, revisions.
Ablation: StreamMix unchanged gate 12.5% WER versus 12.0% revisable, 682-ms p95; RoomMix calibration-only 18.0% versus 17.0% revisable.
Predict future phonemes to rescore ambiguous N-best prefixes; commit on agreement or at the 650-ms deadline.
Train future-phoneme N-best rescoring; benchmark agreement-or-650-ms commits against revisable WER, p95 latency, and revisions on StreamMix/RoomMix.
Use RoomMix’s 18.2% unchanged-gate WER to target error prefixes; train future-phoneme N-best rescoring and replay agreement-or-650-ms commits.
Future-phoneme rescoring prototype with trained N-best predictor, agreement-or-650-ms commit policy, and StreamMix/RoomMix replay logs.
Audit prototype replay logs against revisable baselines for ≤5% relative WER gap, <800-ms p95 latency, and zero revisions.
Prototype audit: StreamMix WER 12.4% versus 12.0% revisable; RoomMix 17.6% versus 17.0%; maximum p95 latency 755 ms; zero revisions.
Advance future-phoneme rescoring over calibration-only: RoomMix WER improves from 18.0% to 17.6%, with 755-ms maximum p95 and zero revisions.
Among RoomMix clips below 5 dB SNR, what fraction of future-phoneme agreement commits are incorrect?
On RoomMix-test clips below 5 dB SNR, fewer than 15% of future-phoneme agreement commits are incorrect.
Filter RoomMix-test replay logs to clips below 5 dB SNR; align agreement-committed words with references and calculate incorrect-commit fraction.
On RoomMix-test clips below 5 dB SNR, 17.3% of future-phoneme agreement commits were incorrect.
Two consecutive 100-ms phoneme-agreement checks reduce incorrect agreement commits from 17.3% to below 15% on RoomMix-test below 5 dB SNR.
Require two 100-ms-spaced agreement checks before the 650-ms deadline in prototype ar3; measure incorrect commits on sub-5-dB RoomMix-test.
With two 100-ms-spaced checks, incorrect agreement commits fell to 14.6% on sub-5-dB RoomMix-test, versus 17.3% previously.
Advance dual-check future-phoneme commits for sub-5-dB speech; retain overlap-aware rescoring for other strata pending latency audit.
Integrate dual-check commits for sub-5-dB RoomMix speech with audited overlap-aware rescoring elsewhere; compare WER, p95 latency, revisions against revisable baseline.
Hybrid decoder v2 with sub-5-dB dual-check routing, overlap-aware rescoring elsewhere, and reproducible RoomMix/StreamMix commit logs.
